original_inputs:
Progress: Internal testing of the customer portal's new login flow is complete. Session timeout and mobile redirect issues were fixed, and the first batch of 120 knowledge-base articles was migrated.
Plans: Open the new login flow to 20 internal pilot users next week and begin migrating the second batch of knowledge-base articles.
Problems: The single sign-on provider has not confirmed the production certificate update schedule, and two critical operating guides still require security-team review.
